description: This file defines a Python class 'MobileNetV2Pretrained' for loading, configuring, and using a MobileNetV2 model for image classification tasks. It includes methods for loading class labels, loading images, setting model weights, and classifying images with top predictions.

classes.name: MobileNetV2Pretrained
